ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: "Why Evolution is True" - This reading group has three aims. First, to read and discuss the multiple lines of evidence for evolution ranging from fossils, to DNA sequence similarity, to experimental studies examining the many facets of evolution. The second goal is to discuss how these ideas can be brought into a K-12 classroom and taught effectively. The third goal is to try to figure out where public misconceptions arise, and how these can be countered.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Sophomore, Junior, or Senior class standing.
